channel.title: [podly] The AI Daily Brief: Artificial Intelligence News and Analysis
channel.description: A daily news analysis show on all things artificial intelligence. NLW looks at AI from multiple angles, from the explosion of creativity brought on by new tools like Midjourney and ChatGPT to the potential disruptions to work and industries as we know them to the great philosophical, ethical and practical questions of advanced general intelligence, alignment and x-risk.

item.title: AI is Too Big to Fail
item.ns0:encoded:
As Senator Adam Schiff pushes to rule out an AI bailout, NLW examines whether Washington could actually let the industry fail. He traces how AI became central to U.S. economic growth and national security under two administrations, then revisits the bank bailouts of 2008 to explore what a government rescue might look like if the AI boom collapses.

item.title: How Anthropic Went From Anti-Product to $81B a Year
item.ns0:encoded:
A Thanksgiving extra from my new show, How We Got Here. In 2021, Anthropic was a safety lab meeting in a park, and its founders had ruled out selling anything. Five years later it was bringing in $81 billion a year. This excerpt from this week's episode covers how that happened: the chatbot they wouldn't release, the investor who turned out to be a fraud, and the bet on coding that changed the business of AI.

Show: https://howwegothere.com/

Full episode link: Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/episode/1MJpqbn3HWleuU9fUoeCX7Apple: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/how-anthropic-went-from-ai-safety-outcast-to-the/id6822359990?i=1000803569349

item.title: Too Big to Fire: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
item.ns0:encoded:

item.title: When AI Labs Rival Nations
item.ns0:encoded:
Anthropic’s IPO has united AI safety advocates and accelerationists around an unlikely concern. If a company gains the kind of influence we associate with a government, what does it owe the public? This Long Read Sunday explores the debate over Anthropic’s power, why some in tech would welcome handing control to AI, and what happens when businesses give agents a goal and let them decide how to reach it.

item.title: Why You Should Try Gemini Neon (Even if You Love Fable)
item.ns0:encoded:
Google’s Gemini Neon edged out Fable on a coding benchmark, but its best pitch may be as a second opinion. NLW shares how Neon helped him find the story in an oil episode that Claude and ChatGPT kept turning into a Wikipedia entry, and what happened when he pushed back on its ideas. In the headlines: Anthropic closes its first day of trading up 17%, and Chinese AI labs warn that new U.S. chip restrictions could delay model releases.
